idea-plugin.name: CaseHub YAML
idea-plugin.description:
Language intelligence for CaseHub YAML formats — completion, diagnostics, hover, rename, find references — powered by the pages-lsp server.

Supported formats

  • *.page.yaml — Page definitions
  • *.case.yaml — Case definitions
  • *.swf.yaml — Serverless Workflow
  • *.htn.yaml — HTN task networks
  • *.org.yaml — Org structure

Requirements

  • Node.js 18+ on PATH
  • LSP4IJ plugin
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release — LSP client via LSP4IJ
  • Schema-driven completion, diagnostics, hover for all five CaseHub YAML formats
  • Rename, find references, go to definition
  • jq expression intelligence
